title: Family-law questions requiring state law
facts: Divorce grounds and procedure, property division, custody standards, parenting-time schedules, ordinary child-support calculations, guardianship and most adoption procedures are governed primarily by state law.
Federal law can affect interstate support enforcement, benefits, taxes, employment leave, immigration and constitutional protections without supplying one national custody or divorce formula.
Hanka should identify the relevant state before giving a concrete divorce, custody, support-calculation or ordinary adoption-procedure answer.
